connection.sql: SELECT current_database() AS database,current_setting('port') AS port,current_setting('server_version') AS server_version,current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS transaction_read_only,current_timestamp AS audit_timestamp

population.sql: SELECT page_namespace,outcome,count(*) AS cases,min(request_timestamp) AS first_request,max(request_timestamp) AS last_request FROM analysis.rfpp_request GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

snapshot_equivalent.sql: SELECT count(*) AS cases,min(request_timestamp) AS first_request,max(request_timestamp) AS last_request FROM analysis.rfpp_request WHERE page_namespace=0 AND outcome IN ('granted','denied')

ecp_candidates_2016_2025.sql: SELECT outcome,count(*) AS cases,count(DISTINCT page_id_match) AS pages,count(*) FILTER(WHERE granted_type='edit' AND granted_level='ecp') AS ecp_log_matches,count(*) FILTER(WHERE granted_type='edit' AND granted_level='semi') AS semi_log_matches,count(*) FILTER(WHERE request_label LIKE '%extended%' AND request_label LIKE '%semi%') AS dual_word_labels FROM analysis.rfpp_request WHERE page_namespace=0 AND outcome IN ('granted','denied') AND requested_action='increase' AND requested_level='ecp' AND request_timestamp >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND request_timestamp < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

missing_tiers_by_year.sql: SELECT extract(year FROM request_timestamp)::int AS request_year,count(*) AS cases,count(*) FILTER(WHERE requested_level IS NULL) AS missing_tier FROM analysis.rfpp_request WHERE page_namespace=0 AND outcome IN ('granted','denied') AND requested_action='increase' AND request_timestamp >= '2013-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND request_timestamp < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

parser_dependency_columns.sql: SELECT table_name,column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='analysis' AND column_name IN ('requested_action','requested_level','board','elig_level_code','elig_level_source','expiry_is_pseudo','rfpp_id') ORDER BY 1,2

reproducer.sql: WITH examples(label,expected_target) AS (VALUES ('extended semi-protection','semi'),('extended semi protection','semi'),('extended temporary semi-protection','semi'),('temporary extended confirmed protection','ecp'),('extended-confirmed protection','ecp'),('semi-protection','semi')), tokens AS (SELECT *,substring(label FROM '(semi|extended|\mecp\M|\mec\M|full|fully|pending|\mpc\M|flagged|template|creat|salt|\mmove)') AS token FROM examples) SELECT label,expected_target,token,CASE WHEN token='semi' THEN 'semi' WHEN token IN ('extended','ecp','ec') THEN 'ecp' END AS old_target FROM tokens ORDER BY label
